content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for OIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for OIL Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time for registration and the personal assessment.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total number of vacancies announced by Oil India Limited?
faq.answer: Oil India Limited has announced a total of 3 contractual positions for various posts through this walk-in recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Contractual Positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for these contractual positions at Oil India Limited.

faq.question: Q5. Which educational qualifications are required for the Contractual Mechanical Supervisor post?
faq.answer: For the Contractual Mechanical Supervisor post, candidates need to have completed Class 10th, a 03-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, and possess at least 02 years of relevant post-qualification work experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Contractual Instrumentation Technician?
faq.answer: The Contractual Instrumentation Technician will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 21450 per month and a variable component of Rs. 825 per day.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the OIL Contractual Positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend a walk-in interview. They should report to the specified venue on the walk-in date with all required original documents and photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the OIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a walk-in for personal assessment, followed by document verification, and finally, the preparation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for Oil India Limited recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is being held in Duliajan, Assam. The specific venue details would be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Does Oil India Limited offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such details.
